scope: Two raw SVG assets from figure-scan.json only; no lesson, course, registry, component, or sourced-image edits.

figures.source_status: Original house construction from the verified DTMF frequency/key mapping; no source image or standards artwork was copied.
figures.teaching_claim: A DTMF decision requires one qualified low-group tone and one qualified high-group tone plus every remaining gate; invalid or incomplete evidence has an explicit REJECT output.

decision_paths: candidate with a failed gate -> REJECT
two tones in one group -> REJECT

semantic_roles.green: confirmed key-5 intersection and qualified KEY path

accessibility: The selected row uses two solid horizontal rules; the selected column uses dashed vertical rules.
Key 5 has a heavy outline and check mark in addition to color.
KEY and REJECT are literal labels with check and X shapes; reject paths are dashed.
A title and factual description are embedded in the SVG.
Every one of the eight frequencies and sixteen key labels remains present at 312 and 360 px.
figures.embed: <Figure src="./figures/dtmf-key-decision-grid.svg" alt="A four-by-four DTMF grid pairs low rows 697, 770, 852, and 941 hertz with high columns 1209, 1336, 1477, and 1633 hertz; row 770 and column 1336 intersect at key 5, while missing, duplicate, or failed gates lead to REJECT." caption="A key exists only at one qualified row-column intersection; every incomplete or conflicting pattern returns REJECT." />

defects_seen: The lower explanatory sentence collided with the dashed arrow entering REJECT.
The X mark collided with the REJECT word.
render_loop.fix: Shortened the secondary annotation and moved the REJECT word right while preserving its terminal box.

render_loop.verdict: PASS in full-size light and dark renders and in 312/360 px light and dark renders.

figures.source_status: Original number-line composition paraphrasing the named AT&T column of ITU-T Q.24 Annex A; no recommendation table, artwork, typography, or wording was reproduced.
figures.teaching_claim: The named profile assigns exactly 23 ms to the non-operation side and exactly 40 ms to the operation-duration side, leaving the open 23-40 ms interval unspecified.

fixtures: 25 ms / 200 samples: indeterminate; exclude from conformance
45 ms / 360 samples: duration gate passes only

semantic_roles.currentColor_solid: non-operation region and closed 23 ms boundary
semantic_roles.green_solid: 40 ms operation-duration boundary and duration-pass fixture

accessibility: The three regions are named directly and differ by solid outline, hatch/dash, and green solid outline.
The 20, 25, and 45 ms fixtures use X, diamond, and check shapes on separate vertical levels.
Inclusive inequality labels establish which side owns each boundary without relying on color.
A title and factual description are embedded in the SVG.
Both boundary values, all region meanings, and all fixture labels remain present at 312 and 360 px.
figures.embed: <Figure src="./figures/dtmf-duration-profile.svg" alt="An AT&T Q.24 Annex A duration band marks at most 23 milliseconds as non-operation, strictly between 23 and 40 milliseconds as an unspecified gray region, and at least 40 milliseconds as the operation-duration region; fixtures at 20, 25, and 45 milliseconds fall into those three regions." caption="The named profile leaves 23-40 ms unspecified; the 25 ms fixture is not conformance ground truth." />

defects_seen: The 45 ms secondary label extended beyond the viewBox.
The >=40 ms boundary label collided with the 50 ms endpoint label.
render_loop.fix: Right-aligned the 45 ms callout, right-aligned the operation-boundary label inside the viewBox, and lowered the 50 ms endpoint label.

render_loop.verdict: PASS in full-size light and dark renders and in 312/360 px light and dark renders.

rights.guardrail: The numeric mapping and named duration boundaries are paraphrased facts; the figures use original geometry, grouping, typography, and decision flow.
